title: eludite.navigation.references input
description: The Find All References window's toolbar and keys: filter by Kind, Group By, search the results, Keep Results (the next search does not replace these results), and step through the references (F8, Shift+F8), opening each. Members left out keep their value.

group_by.description: Group By: Project then File (Visual Studio's default), File, Definition, or a flat list.

search.description: Show only references whose line text, file or project contains this text (case-insensitively).

keep.description: Keep Results: when true the current results stay in the window when the next search runs.

navigate.description: Open the next or previous shown reference (F8, Shift+F8).
